title: Here's all the actors rumoured to be in Rockstar's GTA 6 - Gaming - LADbible
text:
Ah, Grand Theft Auto VI. If you're into gaming, let's face it, you've heard of it.
It's one of the most hyped up games of the year, seeing as fans have had to wait over a decade since it's last installment.
But, since the recent announcement of GTA 6's delay, gamers have had little else to do other than speculate over things such as the game's ending and look for leaks, and even clues in the trailers.
Now, players have started moving away from trying to guess things such as the game features and map, and have instead started looking at the potential actors involved in the upcoming game.
Advert
Where did these GTA 6 cast predictions come from?
There are always lots of rumours and predictions about any game when it draws closer to release, but the issue is knowing which rumours you can trust.
GameRoll, who has a history of making some pretty accurate predictions and leaks about GTA 6, recently released a video on his channel explaining who he thinks the actors are for the upcoming game.
Ready to find out?
Manni L. Perez as Lucia Caminos
The first rumour might not come as a surprise, as plenty of gamers have already compared actress Manni L. Perez's face and voice to that of Lucia's.
Advert
She has also previously admitted that she is working on a project which use motion capture, but at the time, due to NDAs could not talk about the project.
Dylan Rourke as Jason Duval
The next one, which GameRoll admits isn't as obvious, is Dylan Rourke as Jason Duval.
Again, the GTA 6 leaker has compared the voices, claiming that Rourke has a near identical voice to Jason's.
Advert
On top of that, Rourke's resume also has professional motion capture listed, however, to-date he's not yet released anything that uses motion capture.
Finally, Rourke's agency posted back in 2019 that he had been case in a video game booking, further cementing the likelihood of this rumour being true.
Stephen Root as Brian Heder
Brian's casting is by far one of the most interesting, if the rumours are accurate.
Advert
According to GameRoll, Hollywood A-lister Stephen Root could playing Brian Heder in GTA 6.
Root has a massive list of Hollywood movies under his belt, including the critically acclaimed psychological horror, Get Out, and more recently, Dog Man.
Oscar Jaenada as Raul Bautista
Whether it was by accident, or done on purpose, it looks like the actor behind Raul Bautista confirmed his role in the game himself.
Advert
Posting an image of his coffee to Instagram, Oscar Jaenada can be seen rocking a Raul t-shirt, all but confirming his role to fans.
As is the case with Lucia and Jason, Jaenada happens to look almost identical to Raul, making it extremely likely that GameRoll hit the nail on the head with this one.
Reggie Talley as Dre'Quan
After the GTA 6 leaks in 2022, fans got a glimpse of the only character shown to have a speaking role.
It didn't take long before fans stumbled across Reggie Talley, who just happened to have 'Project Fireball' by Rockstar Games on his resume.
See the full video:
There have been plenty of videos, rumours, leaks and other bits of information coming out about the game and it's potential actors.
But, GameRoll does have some pretty compelling evidence, making it seem likely that he's nailed these.
But only time will tell for sure.
If you want to see how GameRoll came to his conclusion over who's playing who in GTA 6, make sure to watch his video above.
